claim_check.claim_reason: The back-translated claim perfectly matches the original meaning. 'Raised' and 'increased' are synonymous in this context, and 'between X to Y' conveys the same range as 'between X and Y'.

chart_check.reason: The term 'true' (referring to the true value) was back-translated as 'Original' in the legend and title. While 'Original' conveys a similar idea of a baseline, 'true' more specifically denotes accuracy or exactness in contrast to an approximation. This is a minor semantic nuance difference, but the overall meaning of comparing a reference value against an approximation is retained. Other text elements are perfectly equivalent.
